question: The 2026 Winter Olympics will be held in ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Italy**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **2026 Winter Olympics** will be held in **Italy**.
 
• Italy was selected as the host country during the 134th IOC Session in Lausanne, Switzerland, on June 24, 2019.
 
• The games will take place in two main venues: **Milan** and **Cortina d'Ampezzo**.
 
• This will be the fourth time Italy hosts the Olympic Games, having previously hosted the Winter Olympics in 1956 in Cortina d'Ampezzo and in 2006 in Turin, as well as the Summer Olympics in 1960 in Rome.
 
• The event is expected to feature multiple winter sports including skiing, ice skating, and snowboarding, among others.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Winter Olympics** is a major international sporting event held once every four years for sports practiced on snow and ice.
 
• The first Winter Olympics was held in **Chamonix, France** in 1924.
 
• Italy has a rich history of winter sports and is known for its alpine skiing resorts.
 
• The **International Olympic Committee (IOC)** is responsible for selecting the host city for the Olympics.
 
• The Winter Olympics includes a variety of sports such as **alpine skiing, cross-country skiing, figure skating, bobsleigh, and ice hockey**.
 
• The event promotes international cooperation and sportsmanship among the participating countries.
